perspective:
Alice’s accessible information:

- She is Alice Lim, a dental hygienist, and Austin Moreno is her old close friend from high school; they discuss personal and professional lives. She knows Austin works in an office/insurance career, different from her healthcare career.
- She noticed Austin had become reserved when talking about work and suspected he might be hiding something about his job performance.
- She invited Austin for coffee. She asked if everything was okay at the office. She heard Austin say it was “nothing really,” just “usual ups and downs,” and then that he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and it was “complicated.”
- After that, she believed Austin might be considering a career change due to work dissatisfaction and felt worried. She asked if he had thought about changing careers and suggested healthcare. She heard him say he had thought about it, was unsure what other paths he could take, asked for her suggestion, and wanted to know more about her experiences and what healthcare involves.
- She sensed Austin was hesitant about changing careers because of fear of the unknown; she felt frustration and empathy. She told him career changes can be daunting and shared that her friend Lara switched to healthcare in her late 30s and was happier. She heard Austin say it was inspiring but he worried about risks and initial struggle. She encouraged him to step out of his comfort zone and offered support. He thanked her, saying her support and real success stories helped.
- Seeing his openness, she felt encouraged and hopeful. She suggested he talk to a career counselor and offered to connect him with friends in healthcare. She heard Austin accept and appreciate this. She said she would set up a meeting next week; he thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, she believed Austin was ready to take next steps and appreciated her help; she felt satisfaction and joy. She told him she was proud and asked how he felt. She heard him say he was excited, a bit nervous, and mostly grateful. She proposed regular check-ins; he agreed, saying they would keep him focused and that her perspective was valuable.
- Her beliefs about Austin hiding something, considering a career change, being hesitant, and being ready are her own impressions/inferences based on what she observed and heard; she does not have access to his private thoughts beyond what he stated.
